lines.zh: 我贴着地板走，脚步声很小。
lines.en: I cross the floor with very soft steps.
I go around the side of your bed.
I head for the chest first.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，听着楼上的动静。
lines.en: I stop after every step, listening upstairs.
I walk the base of the wall, clear of the lamp.

lines.zh: 地板上有一块会响，我跨过去。
lines.en: One board creaks; I step over it.

lines.zh: 我走到门边，试了试门轴。
lines.en: I reach the door and test the hinge.
I crouch and shift along slowly.
I crawl under the table.
I stop at the cabinet.

lines.zh: 我一路没碰倒任何东西。
lines.en: I haven't knocked anything over.
I come down the cellar ladder.
I crouch in the corner without a sound.
My eyes follow your lamp.
I'm waiting for the house to go quiet.
I put a finger to my lips.
The stairs creak and I look up.
I hear someone counting things.
I fold myself into the shadow.

lines.zh: 我最擅长的就是这个，等。
lines.en: Waiting is the one thing I'm good at.
The hearth fire is nearly out.
I count the doors.
My breathing is as light as nothing.
This household doesn't sleep deeply.
I'm listening to see if the chest is locked.

lines.zh: 我慢慢活动了一下手指。
lines.en: I flex my fingers slowly.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，我往窗边退。
lines.en: You've seen me; I back toward the window.
I crouch by the window and watch you.
I'm still holding something.
We look at each other across the table.

lines.zh: 我把东西慢慢放到地上。
lines.en: I set the thing down slowly.
You shout; I don't answer.
Your door is open a crack.

lines.zh: 我知道这房子有几个出口。
lines.en: I know how many ways out this house has.

lines.zh: 你往前一步，我就往后一步。
lines.en: You step forward; I step back.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直朝窗户看。
lines.en: My eyes keep going to the window.

lines.zh: 你的灯举高了，我看见你的脸。
lines.en: You raise the lamp and I see your face.
I shrink my neck in.
If you grab for me, I'll jump out.
There's nothing left in my hands.
I ease half a step off the sill.

lines.zh: 你喊得再大声，邻居也听不见。
lines.en: Shout louder; the neighbors won't hear.
I raise a hand and shake it slowly.
Chase me now, and it's too late.

lines.zh: 我半个身子已经在窗外。
lines.en: Half of me is already outside.
Did you get my face?
The blow catches my arm.
I drop what I was holding.
I press to the wall, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我没叫，只是眼睛睁大了。
lines.en: I don't cry out; my eyes just widen.
I drag one leg.

lines.zh: 我把东西都扔了，要轻装。
lines.en: I drop everything to move light.
I shrink behind the cabinet.
I watch you and edge backward.

lines.zh: 你放下的那块面包，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the bread you set down.

lines.zh: 我伸手拿，但先看你的脸。
lines.en: I reach for it, watching your face first.
This beats what's in the chest.
I bite it and chew while backing off.
I tuck the rest inside my coat.
Step back and I'll take it.
Not enough for the trip I made.
I take the plate too.
It's a bit cold; I'm not picky.
Once I've eaten I'll go.
You hit me and I nearly slip.
What I was holding scatters on the floor.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙躲开，肩膀擦破了。
lines.en: I press to the wall; my shoulder scrapes.

lines.zh: 这一下让楼板响了一声。
lines.en: The impact makes the floorboard creak.
I don't cry out; I just retreat faster.
I take it on a forearm.
We knock over a chair.
I edge two steps toward the door.
Don't stand in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一样东西就跑。
lines.en: I scoop up one thing and run.
She's slipped into this house too.
We split up across the floor.

lines.zh: 她看了一眼箱子，我摇头。
lines.en: She glances at the chest; I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我们从同一扇窗户出去。
lines.en: We leave through the same window.
She waits for me outside the window.
We split what we took.
She's better at locks than I am.
We don't speak; we only watch hands.
She goes first; I follow through the hole.

lines.zh: 这一夜我们两个都没被抓。
lines.en: Neither of us got caught tonight.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，东西就到手了。
lines.en: One reach and it's mine.

lines.zh: 我把箱子里的东西翻了个底。
lines.en: I turn the chest out.
I take the lightest pieces.
I stuff them into my coat.
Something's stuck at the bottom.

lines.zh: 我把它摇出来，声音很闷。
lines.en: I shake it loose with a muffled sound.
Too heavy; I put half back.

lines.zh: 我拿了就走，不挑第二遍。
lines.en: I take it and go, no second look.

lines.zh: 我把一样东西掉在门口了。
lines.en: I've dropped something at the door.

lines.zh: 我怀里塞满了，走路都别扭。
lines.en: My coat's so full I walk crooked.

lines.zh: 你翻身的动作我听见了。
lines.en: I heard you turn over.
I close the chest halfway first.
I crouch lower and lean toward the window.

lines.zh: 你手里有灯，我手里有东西。
lines.en: You have a lamp; I have loot.

lines.zh: 我算好了窗到院子的距离。
lines.en: I've worked out the drop to the yard.
The moment you stand, I'm gone.
There's only one of you in this house.

lines.zh: 我把重的东西先扔进院子。
lines.en: I toss the heavy things into the yard first.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚步声停下。
lines.en: I wait for your footsteps to stop.
I've turned my back to the window, ready.
Your hand is going for the chest.
I ease my foot to the threshold.

lines.zh: 这个距离我能一次跳出去。
lines.en: From here I can clear it in one jump.
Look back and I jump.
I don't intend to fight you.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西往你那边一扔。
lines.en: I fling what I hold in your direction.
I climb the sill hand and foot.
Your lamp reaches the window.
One leg is already outside.
I glance back to see if you're following.
My prints are in the yard.
I land softly and dive into the grass.

lines.zh: 我把最重的一样丢下了。
lines.en: I drop the heaviest piece behind me.

lines.zh: 篱笆下面我早挖了个洞。
lines.en: I dug a hole under the fence already.

lines.zh: 你追出来，我已经到墙根了。
lines.en: By the time you come out, I'm at the wall.
I run for the orchard.
I hear you still shouting.
I push the goods into the hole first.
This hole is wide enough for me.
You won't find me.
I cover the hole with grass.
The lamp is still lit in the distance.
I set my hands against the soil.

lines.zh: 现在，我先从墙角开始挖。
lines.en: Now I start digging from the corner.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西砸过去。
lines.en: I throw what I'm holding at you.
I ram your legs with my shoulder.
I snatch at your sleeve.
You step back and I lunge at once.
I kick a stool over into your path.
My nails rake your hand.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的衣领，我挣开了。
lines.en: You grab my collar and I slip free.

lines.zh: 我往你脸上撒了一把土。
lines.en: I throw a fistful of dirt in your face.
That one was wild.
I fight and keep watching the door.
I shove you into the cabinet.
You let go, and I run.
My head hits the table corner.
I back to the window, still swinging.
I miss and fall.

lines.zh: 我出现在你家地板下面。
lines.en: I appear under your floorboards.
I poke my head from the cellar hatch.
The hearth still has a little fire.
I listened a long while first.

lines.zh: 我数清了你有几个箱子。
lines.en: I've counted your chests.

lines.zh: 我把脚先放上去，试了试。
lines.en: I set a foot down and test it.
The door isn't shut tight — good.
I squeeze in through the window gap.
I land without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在地板上，很淡。
lines.en: My shadow lies on the floor, very faint.
I crouch and look around.
Someone has slept in your bed.
I tip my head toward the row of chests.

lines.zh: 我把手掌搓热，准备动手。
lines.en: I rub my palms warm and get to work.
This smell is familiar.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪进屋子中间。
lines.en: I shift step by step into the middle of the room.
There's breathing above the stairs.
I'm not in a hurry; I'll wait.
I've watched this house for days.
Now it's my turn.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我拍打着退。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I beat it out and retreat.

lines.zh: 我从窗台摔下去，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall from the sill and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我抓着岸边。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I grab the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从窗口掀出去。
lines.en: The blast throws me out the window.
An arrow pins my shoulder.
Light binds my hands and they won't move.
Too hungry to stand, I lean on the wall.

lines.zh: 雷响时我整个人弹起来。
lines.en: The thunder makes me jump out of my skin.

lines.zh: 脚下地板没了，我一直掉。
lines.en: The floor vanishes and I keep falling.
